recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, urban-themed collage featuring a group of figures walking in a candid street scene, framed by torn paper textures, high-contrast black and white graphic elements, and bold, hand-painted white lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the candid, naturalistic photography and the aggressive, tactile collage borders.
Interaction between the white brush-stroke typography and the dark foreground shadows.
Tension between the clean red rectangular block and the rough, torn edges of the surrounding paper layers.
coreInvariants: Torn paper edges with visible white fiber texture.
High-contrast black and white halftone or photocopy textures in the periphery.
Hand-painted, thick-impasto white lettering with visible brush bristles.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five figures occupies the central horizontal band, scaled to appear as if walking toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white brush-stroke title at the bottom foreground acts as the primary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the red block in the top right, moves down through the central figures, and rests on the large white lettering at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows between the figures and the dark asphalt ground provide space for the foreground text to pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black provide the foundation for the urban photography and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white is used for the hand-painted lettering and torn paper edges to create high legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: A single saturated red rectangular block in the upper right provides a focal point.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The central photo uses muted, naturalistic tones, while the surrounding graphic elements use extreme high-contrast black and white.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to black, white, red, and desaturated denim blues/browns.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight sans-serif with irregular, expressive baselines.
letterConstructionRules: Mimic a flat-bristle brush with dry-brush effects at the ends of strokes.
Varying heights and widths for each character to suggest hand-made spontaneity.
Thick, opaque white paint application with visible texture.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminals should show 'feathering' or 'splatter' consistent with fast brush movement.
O and D counters should be slightly irregular and hand-drawn.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, expressive brush script for the title paired with a more rigid, distressed sans-serif for the secondary brand mark.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, energetic feel of the main title.
Matches the secondary text's rough, stamped appearance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a gritty urban collage. The center features a candid photo of a group walking on a dark street. The top border is a torn paper edge revealing a black and white halftone texture. The bottom is dark asphalt. A solid red rectangle is placed in the top right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, thick-stroke white hand-painted lettering across the bottom foreground. Add a secondary distressed white sans-serif text inside the red rectangle. Include small white lightning bolt icons on the left margin.

verificationChecks: Does the bottom text have visible brush bristle textures?
Are the paper edges ragged and white-fringed?
Is the red block a flat, saturated color?
Is the central photography desaturated and moody?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the torn paper texture
Color of the accent block (e.g., blue instead of red)
Thickness of the brush strokes in the main title
Amount of halftone grain in the background
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not look like a standard computer font.
Check that torn edges look like physical paper, not a digital filter.
Verify the red block is the only high-saturation element.
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the 'messy' collage style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Urban Candid Photo] + [Torn Paper Borders] + [Halftone Textures] + [Hand-Painted Brush Lettering] + [Single Saturated Color Block].
